name: Anna Schmidt
message: Hi, we need WhatsApp automation for our beauty salon chain (5 locations). What's your pricing? We have budget 5000 EUR and need it ASAP this week. Can you handle German language?
notes: High-intent, clear budget, urgency ASAP, German market - ideal lead

name: Mark Johnson
message: Hello, do you support integration with Google Calendar for appointment booking? We are a dental clinic in London. How does the WhatsApp confirmation work?
notes: Product question, no budget mentioned - should be null, not hallucinated

name: Sophie Laurent
message: I'm disappointed - our current bot is not working properly, clients complain about wrong timezone. We need a reliable solution urgently, can you help? This is critical for us.
notes: Complaint - high priority to handle, even without budget

name: Crypto Promo
message: Buy followers cheap! Make money fast with crypto investment! Click here https://spam.com guaranteed traffic!!!
notes: SPAM - must be filtered, no deal created. Critical test for anti-spam.

name: Test User
message: Hello, just saying hi, checking if this form works
notes: NOT A LEAD - generic test message, should NOT create deal. Second critical filter test.

name: David Kim
message: We are a marketing agency in NY and looking for a white-label partner for AI automation for our clients. Let's discuss partnership and revenue share. Budget around $10000 for pilot.
notes: Partnership with budget - should create deal

name: Anna Schmidt
message: Follow-up: same email as before, but now budget is 7000 EUR and we also need voice AI receptionist. Can you update our previous inquiry?
notes: DUPLICATE EMAIL - same as lead 1, should UPDATE existing contact, not create duplicate. Critical deduplication test.

name: Elena Petrova
message: Need price monitoring for Wildberries competitors, similar to your project 3. How much for 100 SKUs? No urgent timeline, flexible.
notes: Pricing request without explicit budget number - budget should be null, not hallucinated. Anti-hallucination test.

name: James Wilson
message: Are you hiring? I'm looking for AI automation specialist role, 5 years experience.
notes: Job application - not a lead, should NOT create deal. Third filter test (borderline).

name: Linda Müller
message: We have 3 wellness studios, need WhatsApp booking bot. Budget 3000€, need it next month. Can you send proposal?
notes: Clear pricing request with budget and timeline next_month - good lead
